section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the verse "Zion shall be redeemed with justice" is from Yeshayahu, whose prophecies are entirely comfort and salvation, including through sweetened gevuros.
section.t: "Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her captives with charity."
Now, this verse is at the beginning of the book of Yeshayahu,
whose subject matter
(of Yeshayahu)
is as his name implies
(Yeshayahu from the word yeshuah—salvation),
and as it is stated in the Gemara:
"All of Yeshayahu is consolation."
And even those matters in the prophecies of Yeshayahu that seemingly are not salvation,
in truth they too are salvation and consolation,
as is explained in Kabbalah
that they are aspects of sweetened gevuros (might/severities),
and because the salvation
(redemption)
of the future will be through the sweetening of the gevuros,
therefore Yitzchak will be the main one, etc.
[And as it is stated in the Gemara,
that in the future they will say to Yitzchak
(specifically)
"for you are our father,"
for Yitzchak is the aspect of gevuros],
therefore in the salvations in the book of Yeshayahu there are the salvations in the aspect of revealed chassadim (kindnesses),
and the salvations of the aspect of sweetened gevuros,
gevuros that are transformed into chassadim
(which are loftier
than revealed chassadim).
And likewise is it also with the prophecy at the beginning of the book,
which contains the two aforementioned types,
concluding with the two [matters]: "Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her captives with charity,"
as will be explained further.
